text:
alexa: Quick thought — running a small PLG microexperiment next week around webinar signups + starter credits. three arms: (A) 50 credits + curated prompt templates, (B) 75 credits + guided quickstart (video + checklist), (C) 50 credits + tailored promptpack + a booked office hours slot. target: lift 7d activation from ~12% to ~18% and measure tokens + short-term retention. who can run routing + tagging?

matt: i'm in. recommend we push templates on first successful request rather than at signup — reduces churn from people who never call the API. also let's include a tiny first-5-requests checkpoint.

jordan: agree on first-successful-call send. on routing: we should randomize at signup but only grant credits on first success to avoid gaming. will that work with growth-bot? @growth-bot

sonia: timeline/analytics question — can we mark webinar attendees as a stratifier? want to compare attendees vs non-attendees inside each arm for uplift. also need clarity on conversion event for paid.

growth-bot: @jordan @alexa experiment created: id mf-2026-03-18-lightning. assignment rule: randomized at signup, persisted in user.experiments. grant flow triggers on first success. daily cap settable. doc: https://redwood.internal/experiments/mf-2026-03-18

natalie: creative + copy: i'll draft 3 subject lines + 3 template previews. ETA: EOD Thursday. will post variants in #marketing for quick feedback. emoji: :sparkles:

alexa: budget constraint — pilot cap $5k. breakdown: ~1k users total across arms (randomize evenly). metrics: 7d activation, 14d retention, token consumption, webinar attendance, trial conversion. please add these to the analytics dashboard.

matt: can we A/B small credit amounts inside arms (50 vs 75) or is that too noisy? worried about blowout costs.

alexa: keep it simple for pilot. choose the three arms as outlined; we can micro-split credits in a follow-up if we see signal. set per-user credit cap to 75 and global spend cap to $5k.

jordan: prompt template checklist for templates: include "search->rewrite", "summarize-convo", "refactor-code", and 3 short examples per template. will pull from the prompt library and sanitize.

sonia: analytics ask: please tag cohort with experiment_id and arm. add webinar_attended boolean and first_success_ts. i'll run stratified analysis on Monday after week 1.

natalie: creative plan: teaser post for social + 2 email nudges: (1) immediate onboarding with templates, (2) 48h reminder with use-cases, (3) webinar reminder. will include 1 screenshot of promptpack.

alexa: perfect. quick ops note — snippet for grant payload that eng can use in the grant lambda: ```json
{"experiment_id":"mf-2026-03-18-lightning","arm":"templates","credits":50,"cap_per_user":75}
```

matt: thanks — i'll queue the routing rule and add budget alerts. :thumbsup:

jordan: will prepare promptpack drafts and post in the thread.

natalie: posting copy drafts in #marketing now. :rocket:

sonia: assigning analytics owners: @sonia to run the primary analysis, @jordan to validate promptpack instrumentation.

alexa: awesome — final checklist: creative in by Thu EOD, routing + experiment infra in by Fri noon, launch cohort Mon AM. keep updates in this thread.

matt: noted.

growth-bot: reminder scheduled: experiment rollout checklist ping on 1732260000.
